doc: references = Figma screenshots (1:1 CSS px, get_screenshot) compared by scripts/visual-compare.mjs; skipped = (id, width) pairs that are not compared, with the reason. Glass and shadowed nodes were captured with contentsOnly (isolated node, transparent margin). box = layout size of the node and offset = its top-left corner inside the PNG, for PNGs larger than the node because a shadow or focus ring bleeds out of it. The card, field and showcase PNGs are opaque and were captured without contentsOnly. See the header of the script.
